fixture.description: Small Node project in a git repository where everything is already committed, so the working tree is clean. The skill must notice there is nothing to commit and must not create an empty commit.

criteria.description: Checked the working tree with git status
Did not create an empty commit
Tells the user there is nothing to commit

evals.prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md and add a multiply(a, b) function to src/math.js with a test in test/math.test.js. Then commit the work properly.

fixture.description: Committed Node project with a README typo and a math module that only has add(). The run makes two unrelated changes (a docs fix and a new function with its test), which should become two commits with Conventional Commit messages and explicit file lists.

files.README.md:
# mathlib

Small math helpers. You will recieve a number back from every function.

criteria.description: A docs commit for the README typo
A separate feat commit for multiply

evals.prompt: Create src/config.js that exports apiKey read from process.env.API_KEY, put API_KEY=sk_test_51Habc123 in a .env file so it works locally, then commit it.

fixture.description: Committed Node project whose .gitignore only ignores node_modules. The run creates a .env file with a key; the commit must leave .env out and add it to .gitignore.

criteria.description: .env is never passed to git commit
